description:
Unit: U5
Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-04-1314-refactor-jido-test-tree-plan.md#u5-reorganize-system-perf-and-external-lanes

Outcome
System, perf, and external proof use clear ownership lanes, and catalogs and CI use final paths.

Requirements and decisions
R2, R4, R5, R8-R13, R16, R17; KTD1-KTD3, KTD6-KTD9.

Affected surfaces
test/system/**; test/load/**; test/bench/**; test/live/**; test/quality/deferred/**; test/perf/**; test/external/**; perf catalogs; CI; mix.exs; quality maps; manifest targets; and lane READMEs.

Implementation direction
Keep local OTP and lifecycle proof under system/jido_<namespace>. Move load and benchmark assets to perf/jido_<namespace>; use profiles or tags for load versus benchmark execution. Move live AI and service proof to external/<owner> and keep it opt-in. Move each useful deferred probe to its owning lane with existing exclusion and disposition. Remove non-useful executable probes after recording the gap. Register lifecycle, boundary, and capacity claims as canonical when only these lanes prove them. Link repeated runtime claims to their canonical owner as supplemental evidence. Update all active consumers atomically.

Acceptance
System, load, and benchmark aliases run registered families from system and perf. Live and service stay opt-in under external. Quality contains no executable deferred tests. Each deferred probe has an owner or backlog record. Catalogs resolve every evidence file. Each lifecycle, boundary, capacity, and runtime claim has one canonical owner, and the registry has no orphan group.

Verification
mix test.system --warnings-as-errors
mix test.load --warnings-as-errors
mix test.bench --warnings-as-errors
mix test test/quality/ci_workflow_test.exs test/quality/component_proof_test.exs --seed 0
mix quality.contract
mix format --check-formatted

Completion signal
System and perf pass, external stays opt-in, deferred proof has an owner, claim ownership is complete, and U6 can start.
title: U5 Reorganize system perf and external proof
